{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute number of patients in treatment arm and number who responded
n_treatment = len(treatment_arm)
n_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()

# Compute fraction who responded
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_treatment

# Print the results
print(f"n_treatment = {n_treatment}")
print(f"n_responded = {n_responded}")
print(f"fraction_responded = {fraction_responded}")"}
